about: Trust wrap records at and past the 1 MiB record limit, measured on the compact `fields` (ADR 0051, Limits; ADR 0056, Pins). A `generated` input is `count` pins alike but for their accounts, with `versions` after them: pin i's account, from 0, is `first_account` plus i times `account_step`, read as a 128-bit big-endian integer.

trust_wraps.name: a trust wrap record of the most compared pins that fit 1 MiB
trust_wraps.row: A rotation or a trust record at the record limit
trust_wraps.clause: A rotation or a trust record at the record limit

trust_wraps.name: a trust wrap record of one compared pin more: past 1 MiB, nothing to leave out
trust_wraps.row: A trust record whose alerts, comparisons and replaced IKs alone pass the record limit; a first-use pin with a replaced IK, kept
trust_wraps.clause: A trust record whose alerts, comparisons and replaced IKs alone pass the record limit
